\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-23},
  title = {Condition flags are read as one-sided assertions},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Feature Encoding and Data Validation},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{has\_\allowbreak{}full\_\allowbreak{}service\_\allowbreak{}history}, \texttt{non\_\allowbreak{}smoking} and \texttt{is\_\allowbreak{}rental} stay plain booleans.
They mean ``the seller asserted this'' or ``the seller did not assert this'', never ``yes'' or ``no''.
No three-valued encoding is built.
\texttt{is\_\allowbreak{}used} is not a feature, because \texttt{offer\_\allowbreak{}type} carries the same information reliably.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A three-valued encoding, or \texttt{False} mapped to missing: the third state would be empty, and a tree splits \texttt{\{True, NaN\}} exactly like \texttt{\{True, False\}}.
\item Drop the flags: discards the reliable half, since a \texttt{True} is a real assertion.
\item Recover the value from the free text: multilingual text parsing is out of scope and has no ground truth.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} A listing form offers a checkbox, so a tick is evidence and an empty box is the absence of evidence.
No encoding can separate ``no'' from ``not stated''.
The risk is a reader who takes \texttt{False} as a denial, so the fix belongs in the problem specification, the dataset card and the model card.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {The three-valued encoding was AI's own earlier proposal in issue \#25.
On re-reading the issue, AI argued against it and showed that it adds a state without adding information for tree models.
Lukas accepted the reversal because the argument was concrete.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-29 on issue \#25; Lukas chose ``keep them binary''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/25}{Issue \#25}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{problem specification}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/dataset-card.md}{dataset card}.},
}
